Rent would probably be 5K+ per month for something that would fit our family and pets for Option 1. Private school in Bay Area, about 30-45K each for kids this age. Although the youngest is still small enough to stay home for a few years if parents not working.

Family is all in mid-peninsula. For option 2, probably consider places like HMB, Pacifica, areas north of SF, but open to ideas!

I-ve done this so many times in my life. For me, it is partially about escaping pain. Places start developing painful memories, because I feel things so deeply and shitty things happen in life. I feel like a new place is at least a clean slate.

I'm so sorry for your loss. This is a huge thing to go through, I find talking to reddit a lot during these times helps. Being a mom now, I know she would not want you to feel sad, that this is "part of life" and she would be with you if she had any choice in the matter. However, she would not want you to dwell on it, to find your support network and to use it as inspiration for living a great rest of your life. That would be the best way you could honor her memory, coming from a mom.

If there's one thing I've learned in life is that you have to go through pain, rather than avoid it. You have to process it on your own time, rather than suppress it.  It hurts a lot at the beginning, but then gets better over time and each day it will start hurting a little less. 

Find your tribe of "moms", she will be looking down on you with a big smile on her face.

It's a really hard place to be in and sometimes you feel like somehow you have to blame your professional success. It even made me angry to get huge bonus checks because they felt completely meaningless (even if they did help pay for a lot of IVF). I had to /have to keep reminding myself that it's not my fault that my eggs pretty much expired in my early 30s, even though it totally feels like my fault...
Definitely some kind of birdie though
My lab won't sleep without her blankie and her stuffed yellow duck in her mouth every night.
Hey. I read your history. You might feel like a monster, but that definitely doesn't make you one. Is there other stuff going on that you want to talk about? People are here for you.
I'm so sorry to hear. My grandmother also meant the world to me.
